sloka: यस्यामेव विधः स्वप्नो दुःखितायां प्रदृश्यते ।सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता प्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ।। ५.२७.४२।।।।
transliteration: yasyāmeva vidhaḥ svapno duḥkhitāyāṁ pradṛśyate ।sā duḥkhairvividhairmuktā priyaṁ prāpnotyanuttamam ।। 5.27.42।।।।

translations.english: "When any demoness in a sorrowful state dreams this kind of dream, she will be relieved of sorrow and will obtain supreme joy.
